summary: Independent verification of QA queue visibility improvement (GET /api/qa/queues + /qa-queues page). Backend focused suite passes 29/29 in 29.5s (test_sample_qa_queue.py 8, test_sample_completeness.py 7, test_sample_instrument_traceability.py 14) against live https://lims-execute.preview.emergentagent.com. QA/Admin API returns 200 with sample_queues + sample_queue_counts containing exactly the six required keys (ready_for_review, blocked_incomplete, oos_investigation, instrument_issue, approved, returned_rejected); QC receives 403 (detail 'Insufficient permissions for this action'). Classifications validated on isolated QAQ-* points/samples: (a) valid pH result + submit -> ready_for_review with attention_reasons=[]; (b) historically visible incomplete Methanol/Formaldehyde sample -> blocked_incomplete with reason exactly '2 required result(s) outstanding: Methanol, Formaldehyde'; (c) failed pH result -> oos_investigation with 'OOS result: pH'; (d) historical invalid instrument (results.0.instrument_id='10') -> instrument_issue with human-readable reason 'Instrument traceability: pH: ... not registered' (no UUID); (e) QA-approved sample -> approved, absent from ready_for_review; (f) QA-rejected sample -> returned_rejected AND oos_investigation; (g) combined incomplete + invalid-instrument sample appears in both blocked_incomplete and instrument_issue with per-category reasons. Frontend as QA on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): /qa-queues renders data-testid=qa-queues-page + data-testid=sample-qa-queue-panel FIRST (DOM order sample-panel precedes queue-awaiting-review batches panel), all six data-testid=sample-qa-filter-<key> buttons show live counts (Ready 8, Blocked 40, OOS 50, Instrument 37, Approved 59, Returned 32; total 167), each filter selection renders sample-qa-queue-row-<record_id> rows with sample-qa-queue-link-<record_id> Links to /samples/{id} and sample-qa-attention-<record_id> summary cells; multi-classification confirmed (REC-20260201-0458 appears in both oos_investigation and returned_rejected). Empty-state test-id sample-qa-empty-state exists in DOM path but was not triggered live because every category has rows in current seed data - it is conditionally rendered when rows.length===0 (verified by static inspection of QAQueues.jsx). QC frontend: /qa-queues renders 'Access denied for your role.' with no sample-qa-queue-panel and direct fetch of /api/qa/queues returns 403. No page runtime errors (page.on('pageerror') captured 0); console 401 lines are the expected /auth/me exempt-path calls before login. No source files modified.
critical_code_review_comments: sample_qa_queue.build_sample_qa_queues loads a fixed 500 samples via .to_list(500) with no pagination. Current live data shows 167 records in the attention set already; when the sample corpus grows past 500 the queue silently truncates the oldest classifications. Consider paginating or filtering server-side by qa_status/status before slicing.

sample_qa_queue._instrument_attention downgrades all inactive/overdue/failed/unavailable messages to 'Instrument unavailable or overdue: <code>' only when a registered_instrument_code exists; if the record was corrupted with a bare UUID that does not resolve to a registered instrument, the raw reason (which may contain the UUID) is surfaced via 'Instrument traceability: <param>: <reason>'. Verified live no UUIDs leak today, but instrument_traceability.assess_instrument_traceability should be double-checked to ensure it never composes the raw supplied identifier into the reason string.

QAQueues.jsx conditionally renders sample-qa-empty-state inside the sample table body only when rows.length===0. That is correct, but since sample_qa_filter defaults to 'ready_for_review', when the ready queue has zero rows the empty state is shown as the very first content of the page - which is the intended sensible behaviour and confirmed by static review.

QAQueues.jsx passes the entire sample panel through a single useState('ready_for_review') without persisting the filter to URL/query params. Refreshing the page always resets to Ready for QA review. Not a defect for this scope but a UX opportunity.
sample_qa_queue.build_sample_qa_queues does not exclude soft-deleted samples if any exist in the samples collection; add an explicit filter if soft-delete is later introduced.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6 filters, 6 classifications, QA panel-first order, mobile render, QC 403 UI + 403 API)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create isolated QAQ-* sample points and per-parameter specifications plus 7 samples across the seven scenarios; the module-scoped autouse fixture clean_isolated_queue_records deletes oos_log, audit_trail, samples, specifications, and sample_points for those ids after the module completes. No persistent master-data records created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/qa/queues is QA/Admin only and includes both the historic batch queues (awaiting_review/on_hold/certificates_to_send/reissue_required) and the new sample_queues + sample_queue_counts payload. Live counts at time of testing: ready_for_review=8, blocked_incomplete=40, oos_investigation=50, instrument_issue=37, approved=59, returned_rejected=32. To exercise sample-qa-empty-state live, filter to a classification that is currently empty (none today) or wipe the seed. QC hitting /qa-queues renders literal text 'Access denied for your role.' rather than redirecting - useful signal for future automated selectors. Backend tests must be run against the ingress URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) because they exercise the same auth pipeline.
rca of the issue: No defect found. QA queue visibility feature meets every acceptance criterion in the review request: 200/403 role gating, all six classification keys returned, correct per-classification attention_reasons (including exact outstanding-name text and no UUID leakage on instrument issues), multi-classification records appearing in every applicable queue, QA-approved samples excluded from ready_for_review, QA-rejected samples in both returned_rejected and oos_investigation, sample panel rendered first on /qa-queues, six data-testid filter buttons with live backend counts, per-row sample-qa-queue-link-{record_id} and attention summary, conditional sample-qa-empty-state, QC blocked both at UI and API layer, and desktop+mobile render cleanly with no runtime page errors.
